text: MARLBORO SKI CHALLENGE AGREEMENT
THIS AGREEMENT is made as of the
day of
1983, between Philip Morris U.S.A., a division of Philip Morris
Incorporated, 120 Park Avenue, New York, New York 10017,
("Philip Morris") and Aspen Skiing Company, 0060 Atlanta Avenue,
Aspen, Colorado 8l6ll, an owner/operator of skiing facilities
located in Aspen, Colorado ("Aspen").
RECITALS
WHEREAS, Philip Morris desires to establish a promotional
program involving a ski race course and automated timing,
referred to as the Marlboro Ski Challenge ("MsC"), to be con-
ducted at Aspen's skiing facilities, to promote and foster recre-
ational skiing in the United States and to provide commercial
identification related to the MSC for Philip Morris' Marlboro
brand;
WHEREAS, Aspen desires to promote and foster recreational
skiing in the United States and to conduct the MSC at its skiing
facilities in Aspen, Colorado; and
WHEREAS, the parties desire by the terms of this agreement
to set forth their respective rights, obligations and
responsibilities in regard to the MSC.
NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants
contained herein, the parties covenant as follows:
1. MSC Eguipment. Philip Morris agrees to provide all
electronic and mechanical equipment and supplies necessary to
conduct the MSC on Aspen Mountain, in Aspen, Colorado. It is
understood that the MsC on-site eguipment will consist of an
automated timing and racing system manufactured by Reliable
Racing Supply. The elements of that system include: automated
timing eguipment that has the capability for side-by-side ski
racing; a large time display near the finish of the course; an
individual results printout; a total results printout of the
times of each day's skiers in order of finish; dual pro starting
gates; slalom poles; all fencing necessary to. enclose the racing
area; and all the miscellaneous fixtures and supplies reguired
for the proper operation of the MSC. Philip Morris shall be
responsible for the installation and removal of the MsC at the
